title: Quest pointer and a cleaner screen
changes: An arrow around your hero points to your current quest objective and shows how many steps away it is.
Quests are back on the right. Each quest stays folded until you start it; click its title to open or fold it.
The menu buttons (with Quests) are big icons beside the angel; chat sits in the bottom-left corner; your group is listed at the top left; the safe zone line is gone.
Every wizard skill now goes to rank 6, upgrades included.
